title: Kaldewei: Milestones of corporate history
content: **From small business to a global partner for high-end bathroom solutions: the KALDEWEI brand history is also a success story. The premium supplier of shower surfaces, bathtubs and enamelled washbasins manufactures solely at its corporate headquarters in Germany, and its facilities are the most advanced in the world. The unique material, KALDEWEI steel enamel, is not only at the core of the brand but is also the reason for the success of every product over decades.**. Over the course of almost 100 years, the company founded in Ahlen by Franz KALDEWEI in October 1918 has developed from being a small business into one of the leading manufacturers of steel enamel bathroom solutions. This is the period during which KALDEWEI makes its name as a pioneer in the development and manufacturing of enamelled shower trays and bathtubs – a reputation it has maintained right up to the present day.
